message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mbedtls && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('tests/fuzz/corpuses/client').read_bytes()
off=0
rec=0
while off+5<=len(b):
 typ=b[off]; ver=b[off+1:off+3].hex(); ln=int.from_bytes(b[off+3:off+5],'big')
 print('rec',rec,'off',off,'type',hex(typ),'ver',ver,'len',ln,'end',off+5+ln)
 if typ==22:
  p=off+5; end=off+5+ln
  while p+4<=end:
   ht=b[p]; hl=int.from_bytes(b[p+1:p+4],'big')
   print('  hs off',p,'type',hex(ht),'len',hl,'end',p+4+hl)
   if ht==11:
    q=p+4
    cl=int.from_bytes(b[q:q+3],'big'); print('    chain',cl)
    r=q+3
    c=0
    while r+3<=q+3+cl:
     certlen=int.from_bytes(b[r:r+3],'big'); print('    cert',c,'off',r+3,'len',certlen); r+=3+certlen; c+=1
   p+=4+hl
 off+=5+ln; rec+=1
 if off>=len(b)-2: print('trailing',len(b)-off, b[off:].hex()); break
PY
